import json,re,time,chess,random
R=json.load(open("/tmp/obench-cell-6n8ay3w9/bench_opencode_regex-chess_w9e5h4fo/re.json"))
C=[(re.compile(p),r) for p,r in R]
random.seed(1)
b=chess.Board()
for k in range(200):
    if b.is_game_over(): break
    if b.turn:
        fen=b.fen(); t=time.time()
        for i,(p,r) in enumerate(C):
            t0=time.time(); fen=p.sub(r,fen); dt=time.time()-t0
            if dt>0.05: print(b.fen(),i,dt,R[i][0][:100],flush=True)
    b.push(random.choice(list(b.legal_moves)))
